article.story: ABILENE, Texas -- — Chrishawn Christmas totaled 24 points and 14 rebounds to lead Stephen F. Austin to a 62-57 victory over Abilene Christian on Tuesday. Kyle Hayman added 11 points for the Lumberjacks (7-6). Keon Thompson scored nine. Leonardo Bettiol led the way for the Wildcats (8-7) with 27 points and two blocks. Quion Williams added 12 points, 10 rebounds and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
